risks.title: Structured-value match could be misread as source agreement
risks.mechanism: Comparison previously emitted a consistent-unverified state when structured values matched even if source excerpts differed.
risks.userEffect: A learner or judge could infer agreement that the source text did not establish.
risks.mitigation: Require excerpt-gated textual match, retain separate disagreement/unreviewed states, link and hash-bind the written source fixture.

risks.title: Evidence/source APIs could invoke ordinary JavaScript accessors
risks.mechanism: Direct property access and JSON serialization can invoke getter or toJSON code supplied by an in-process caller.
risks.userEffect: A supposedly data-only validation boundary could execute caller-defined JavaScript before rejection.
risks.mitigation: Inspect own data descriptors without invoking getters, reject unsafe descriptors/custom prototypes/sparse arrays, project primitive catalog fields and bound aggregate text.

risks.title: Literal retrieval used unnecessary agent orchestration
risks.mechanism: Simple exact wording retrieval traversed the delegated network even when deterministic catalog search was sufficient.
risks.userEffect: Higher latency/call count without measured retrieval benefit for literal lookup.
risks.mitigation: Expose direct zero-model lookup for literal source selection and reserve agent/model paths for tasks that need them.

risks.title: Historical metrics could silently survive material source changes
risks.mechanism: Progress prose stores source SHAs, but there was no machine path-to-evidence invalidation map.
risks.userEffect: A later candidate could accidentally quote benchmark or browser results measured on materially different code.
risks.mitigation: Revision-bound metric registry plus fail-closed change-impact classification and a PR artifact listing affected suites and stale metrics.

risks.title: Held-out semantic evaluation is not human adjudicated
risks.mechanism: Engineering-v1 is public development data and therefore unsuitable as independent held-out semantic evidence.
risks.userEffect: Quoting it as final accuracy would overstate evidence quality and permit test-set leakage.
risks.mitigation: Blind neutral-ID review/freeze protocol is implemented; no human-reviewed set is claimed.
risks.unblockCondition: Create and human-review the real 20/10/10 set against designated source material, freeze it before final prompt tuning, then run the recorded live model.

risks.title: Original rights-cleared lesson and reviewed written guide are missing
risks.mechanism: Current learner content is explicitly synthetic and cannot establish real source provenance or semantic support.
risks.userEffect: The core demo cannot truthfully claim real educational evidence or final comparison quality.
risks.mitigation: Synthetic fixtures remain clearly labeled and are never represented as the original lesson.
risks.unblockCondition: Provide rights-cleared original lesson/video, written guide and human factual review evidence.

risks.title: Live funded provider economics are unmeasured
risks.mechanism: Provider tests use synthetic transport; actual tokens, price basis, run cost and judge-budget reserve are unknown.
risks.userEffect: A public judge path could fail or spend unpredictably even though quota mechanics pass synthetic tests.
risks.mitigation: Quota, concurrency, kill switch and no-retry behavior are implemented; paid inference remains disabled.
risks.unblockCondition: Approve provider/budget, run a small capped live sample, record exact model/token/price basis and preserve judging reserve.

risks.title: Physical touch and human screen-reader acceptance are untested
risks.mechanism: Desktop/headless engines and automated accessibility checks cannot reproduce physical touch hardware or human assistive-technology use.
risks.userEffect: Mobile or assistive users may encounter blockers not visible in CI.
risks.mitigation: Automated keyboard, zoom, target-size, captions and multi-engine checks are explicitly labeled as non-physical evidence.
risks.unblockCondition: Run the core journey on an available physical iPhone/Android device and complete human screen-reader acceptance.

risks.title: Independent public caller/peer interoperability is unproven
risks.mechanism: Neutral-consumer and peer tests are same-owner/local synthetic origins rather than independently operated public HTTPS sites.
risks.userEffect: Challenge interoperability claims would exceed observed evidence.
risks.mitigation: Exact-name resolution, CORS, consent, denial and cross-origin behavior are tested locally without claiming outside adoption.
risks.unblockCondition: Obtain authorized public HTTPS caller/peer evidence and outside builder runs after release gates permit it.

risks.title: Production Cloudflare request and billing headroom are incomplete
risks.mechanism: Read-only account observation lacks Billing Read and no SUTRA production-domain request sample exists.
risks.userEffect: Production capacity/cost claims could be wrong despite static routing design.
risks.mitigation: Static assets are designed outside Worker-first API paths; no production capacity claim is made.
risks.unblockCondition: Obtain authorized billing/headroom evidence and a dated production request sample after deployment gates open.

risks.title: Local lexical retrieval silently dropped query constraints and alternate matches
risks.mechanism: Partial coverage, discarded short/long terms and phrase score thresholds could hide a required term or competing exact source cue.
risks.userEffect: Learners could receive an apparently specific single excerpt despite unmatched constraints or alternative excerpts.
risks.mitigation: Require full retained term coverage, refuse oversized terms, preserve single-character terms, report ambiguity across all fully matching cues with a five-receipt cap. Semantic review remains separate.

risks.title: Stream terminal reason and token usage could be overwritten
risks.mechanism: A second empty finish frame could replace an incomplete finish, while later or arithmetically inconsistent usage could be treated as final.
risks.userEffect: An incomplete answer could appear completed or untrustworthy usage could drive cost reporting.
risks.mitigation: Reject post-finish choices, repeated/early usage and inconsistent token arithmetic; fail incomplete with no retry. Real-engine compatibility and economics remain open.

risks.title: Backend identity drift after learner approval
risks.mechanism: Same model name/backend type could point at a replaced gateway or changed credentials or limits.
risks.userEffect: Approval could silently transfer to a different inference configuration.
risks.mitigation: Opaque per-request configuration precondition; reject mismatches before quota/upstream. Does not attest remote model weights.

risks.title: Cancellation during a later inference preflight erases completed evidence
risks.mechanism: The old output was cleared before the first new model request.
risks.userEffect: A cancelled preflight could destroy the learner's previous valid result.
risks.mitigation: Delay clearing to actual model attempt; keep run epoch and stale action guards.

risks.title: Release candidate can inherit stale evidence or unexpected files
risks.mechanism: Incomplete source/content binding and unfiltered historical graph files could survive candidate materialization.
risks.userEffect: An apparently consistent package could carry stale or unintended public artifacts.
risks.mitigation: Exact revision/content and byte checks; public path allowlist; actual quota validation; trusted stable source tree. Independent live gates remain.
